name: Pixel Arcade HD
mo_ta_vi: Hoạt hình kể chuyện pixel 16-bit: khung gốc 480x270 phóng 4x, nhân vật có biểu cảm, cắt theo key pose, bảng 32 màu cố định.
summary: 16-bit HD pixel storytelling; 480x270 canvas at 4x, rigged expressive characters, stepped motion, 32-colour palette.
character: A narrated comedy told in 16-bit pixel art: hard pixel edges, characters with readable faces and lip-sync, pose-to-pose cuts with holds and smears, parody set-pieces (news, documentary) rendered as pixel scenes.

palette.rule: 32-colour song-lag-32 palette only; no gradients or alpha blends; shading by per-character ramps and dithered tiles

typography: VT323 (Vietnamese-complete) for all on-screen text, sizes multiples of 4 px at art resolution, rendered to canvas and alpha-thresholded to a single palette colour
layout: Base canvas 480x270 art px; 1 art px = 4 screen px; every position snapped to whole art px
No HUD by default; diegetic text only (signs, screens, news lower-thirds)
material: Flat pixel sprites and tiles; 1 art px (4 screen px) outline in palette index p; image-rendering pixelated on all art
texture: Parallax tile layers moving in whole art px
camera: Pan in whole art px steps (4 screen px)
Screen shake 1 art px for up to 4 steps
Zoom only at integer scales (1x, 2x) through an iris transition
transitions: pixel-dissolve (mosaic block 1 -> 8 -> 1 art px, stepped, 0.4 s)
iris (square closes on subject in 6 steps, opens on next)

pacing.rhythm: Comedy timing first: holds before punchlines, hard cuts on the joke beat; music follows the narration.

beat_response: HUD score digits tick up on every beat
Coins or stars bounce one tile on kick beats
Background tiles shift one art pixel on kick downbeats
ui_choreography: UI redrawn as pixel panels with 8 px borders
Menu cursor arrow jumps between items on spoken words
Items appear with a power-up pop (scale 0 -> 1.25 -> 1, steps(3))
Numbers count through odo in pixel digits
diagrams: Flows as tile maps: nodes are blocks, paths drawn tile by tile
Bar charts as stacked 8 px blocks filling in steps
character_motion: on2 = 12 steps/s; rig tweens only blink, mouth visemes, eye darts, 1-2 art px head bob/breathing
large actions cut to key poses with holds and 2-3 frame smears
lip-sync from Vietnamese syllable visemes with a 2-step minimum hold
captions: No burned-in captions; subtitles delivered via YouTube CC
sound: chiptune is NOT mandatory: parody genres (news fanfare, product-intro bed, temple bell) are allowed as deliberate exception
SFX short and punchy, synced to pose cuts

signature_moves: Pose-cut punchline with a 2-3 frame smear
Freeze-frame with spinner for meta jokes
strengths: Great for developer and gaming audiences
constraints: All positions and sizes snap to the 480x270 art grid (4 screen px)
Motion uses stepped timing at 12 steps/s; no eased tweens on sprites
Fixed 32-colour palette; no gradients or blur
